display.purpose: Hero headline only — the largest text on the page.

label.purpose: Chips, badges, section tags. Uppercase, tight tracking.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all framer-motion/motion transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Standard reveal duration for itemVariants, fadeInUp.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Slightly longer reveal for fadeInUp (hero, large cards).

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Stagger delay between children in containerVariants.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Midnight Navy CTA — the only element that uses the accent as a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: none; font-family: 'Geist Pixel', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Border-only button for secondary actions. Transparent background, border at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); font-family: 'Geist Pixel', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No background, no border. Appears on hover only. Used for inline actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: none; font-family: 'Geist Pixel', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary card surface. Flat at rest, 1px border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; }

components.name: Card-2
components.description: Secondary card surface for sub-cells and nested content.
components.css: .ds-card-2 { background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Frosted pill for badges and labels over images. Semi-transparent + backdrop-blur.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: rgba(18,18,22,0.55); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid rgba(37,37,48,0.7); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }

components.name: Nav Pill (Active)
components.description: Active navigation state. Solid accent background, no gradient.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.375rem 1rem; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-foreground); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-nav-pill:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card (Signature)
components.description: The sole glass accent — frosted surface with backdrop-blur. Used once per view for the most important elevated element.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(18,18,22,0.55); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid rgba(37,37,48,0.7); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a single, carefully balanced dark surface where visitors come to verify evidence — repos, internship details, resume — not to be dazzled. The design is architectural: every element has a clear spatial reason, and nothing exists for decoration alone. The blue glow is not a wash; it is a deliberate signal, appearing only on hover, focus, and active interaction. Glass — the frosted, semi-transparent surface — is the only material accent, used exactly once per view to draw the eye to the most important element without competing with the work itself.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, flat background with no full-page gradient
Glass (backdrop-blur + frosted border) as the single material accent
Blue glow (#4a55d6) reserved exclusively for hover/focus/active states
Geist Pixel typeface throughout — tight headings, comfortable body text
Consistent card rhythm: surface / surface-2 cards with 1px border
Mobile-first responsive, sticky sidebar on lg+

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: Midnight Navy appears on ≤10% of any given viewport. Its scarcity is the point — it marks the primary action, nothing else.

rules.name: The Glow-Only-on-Action Rule
rules.body: The blue glow (Periwinkle or Midnight Navy) appears only in response to user interaction — hover, focus, or active tap. It is never a static decorative element.

rules.name: The Tight-Headings Rule
rules.body: All headings use tracking-tight and line-height: 1.15. No exceptions. Loose headings break the architectural feel.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest. No shadows, no tonal shifts, no gradients appear in the default state. Lift and depth are reserved for interaction moments.

dos: Do keep the background flat and dark — no gradient, no tonal shift as visitors scroll.
Do use glass (backdrop-blur + frosted border) as a single, deliberate accent per view.
Do reserve blue glow for hover, focus, and active tap only — never idle.
Do maintain the 10% accent rule — Midnight Navy marks the primary action, nothing else.
Do use tight headings (tracking-tight, line-height: 1.15) throughout.
Do keep card backgrounds flat (surface / surface-2) with a 1px border.
donts: Don't use a full-page gradient as the body background.
Don't fill CTA buttons or nav pills with a gradient — use solid Midnight Navy.
Don't show idle glow or pulsing blue effects on any surface.
Don't use box-shadow as a decorative element — depth is border-based only.
Don't hardcode hex values in components — reference tokens (var(--color-accent)).
Don't add decorative elements that don't serve a spatial or interaction purpose.
